hotlists: National Crime Information Center (NCIC) which includes vehicles wanted for crimes, missing and wanted persons, AMBER & Silver Alerts
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Loveland OH PD and is never sold to 3rd parties. Data is stored for 30 days, deleted, and is not recoverable.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access is limited to authorized department staff based on their assigned roles and job responsibilities, following the principle of least privilege. Access requires a valid law enforcement purpose and is logged indefinitely, allowing for compliance audits and verification. To further safeguard this data, our agency utilizes multi-factor authentication (MFA), which requires additional identity verification before access is granted.
hotlist_policy:
Hotlist hits are required to be verified prior to action by officers.
Myth vs. Fact
Myth
